spec_match.rationale: Implements the spec transfer curve (E = 1.055·L^(1/2.4) − 0.055 with the 12.92·L linear segment) and, on supporting browsers, cross-checks it against the browser's own RCS conversion into display-p3.

interactive.rationale: Slider drives an SVG curve marker, four live numeric readouts, a copyable two-declaration CSS block, and the browser cross-check line.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises an inspection tool with a browser cross-check on 144+; page delivers both, with the cross-check honestly marked unavailable pre-144.

edge_cases.rationale: Both formula branches exercised (0.002 -> linear segment, 0.75 -> power segment); clipboard failure path degrades to a manual-copy instruction; unsupported browsers get labelled JS math, never fake browser output.

conformance.rationale: The suite's linear-transfer-matches-spec-curve assertion pins the same 0.5 -> 0.73536 contract this tool computes.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (pre-144 engine) via CDP/puppeteer: every control driven at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; full-page screenshots read; console clean except a sandbox-blocked external Google Fonts fetch (net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET, environment egress proxy, not the demo); zero same-origin failures; zero horizontal overflow. Copy button verified ('copied ✓').

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts browser-matches-spec on interaction when supported and an explicit no-rcs fallback-branch assert otherwise.

design_system.rationale: Variables for all UI; dark code block uses --text-black/--bg-ivory pair (19.7:1).

accessibility.rationale: Labelled slider, titled SVG with role=img, aria-live cross-check and copy status; a squeezed definition-list column that broke value legibility was caught on the desktop screenshot and fixed.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Zero overflow both classes; converter grid reflows to one column at 360px.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the supported path on Chrome 144+
openQuestions.detail: Verification ran on Chromium 141, which predates the feature, so only the unsupported/fallback branch could be exercised in-browser (it behaved correctly and honestly). When a 144+ Chrome/Canary is available, re-run the page: the support badge must flip, chips/bars must render in display-p3-linear, and the RCS cross-checks must report agreement within tolerance.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo layout without horizontal overflow mobile touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Design tokens/variables, >=44px touch targets, visible focus, :not()-style intent selectors, gradients/color-mix guidance.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All chrome UI colours use public/styles.css variables; range inputs and buttons have min-height 44px; native controls keep default focus rings; wide content scrolls in its own overflow-x container.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic sizing (minmax(min(Npx,100%),1fr)) grids instead of fixed columns so panels reflow on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Swatch pairs, converter panel, mix grid and supports cards all use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(...,100%),1fr)); dl uses max-content/minmax(0,1fr) after a squeezed-column bug was caught on the desktop screenshot and fixed.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: puppeteer probe: documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth == 0 at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 on all four concepts

guidanceConsulted.query: interactive color space demo slider controls accessible live readout
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label every control, expose state changes through text/live regions, keep keyboard operability with native elements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Sliders are native inputs wrapped in labels with output elements; verdict/readout containers use role=status aria-live=polite; grey ladder exposes a role=img description; tab order verified (crumbs -> sliders) and ArrowRight moves the slider and updates the readout.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP keyboard pass: activeElement sequence + slider 0.50->0.51 with readout update

summary: Inspection-tool angle. Chromium 141 verification: both curve branches compute correctly, marker geometry follows the slider, copy works, and the cross-check honestly reports 'unavailable' with the JS-math labelling rather than a faked agreement. Layout bug (1-character-wide value column from a long dt) found via screenshot inspection and fixed before commit.
